text:
Maya: hi team — first week here. I'm trying to open the 'dev API' dashboard in Grafana but a few panels are showing 'No data' / blank. Also I don't have access to Sentry for the dev org (can't view errors). Who should I ping to get Grafana + Sentry access? My email is maya.k@redwood.com

devex-bot: welcome, Maya! Quick checklist you can try first:
1) Request Grafana access via identity portal: https://id.redwood.com/requests
2) Sentry invites are usually handled by infra/sre — email infra-oncall@redwood.com or use the onboarding form: https://go.redwood/obs-onboard :sparkles:

Devon: hey @Maya — welcome! I'll help. Are you trying to view project 'redwood-dev/api' or 'redwood-dev/ingest'? Also what value do you have set for the 'cluster' / 'environment' variable (prod/stage/dev)?

Maya: thanks @Devon — it's 'redwood-dev/api' and cluster=dev. Screenshot: https://i.imgur.com/placeholder.png (shows the top panels blank).

Devon: OK I'm adding you to the Grafana org now. After I add you, refresh and make sure dashboard variable `cluster` is set to `dev`. If panels still show blank, open the panel and paste the query inspector output or the panel JSON and I'll take a look.

Priyanka: @Maya I can send the Sentry invite — what's the email/username you use? The dev Sentry org is at: https://sentry.io/organizations/redwood-dev/issues/?project=12345 — FYI we recently tightened project visibility so you need to be a member of the org to see issues.

Maya: maya.k@redwood.com. Also one panel has a console error: `Error: Panel failed to load: fetch failed 502`.

Devon: the 502 usually means Grafana failed to proxy to Prometheus (timeout or backend). Quick debug steps:
- Edit panel > Query inspector > click 'Request' and paste the request/response.
- Or run locally: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_API_KEY' "https://grafana.redwood/api/datasources/proxy/1/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m]))"```
If you paste the Query Inspector output I can see whether it's a prometheus 502 or a Grafana proxy error.

Priyanka: invite sent to maya.k@redwood.com — you should get an email shortly. If it doesn't arrive, check spam or accept from https://sentry.io/auth/login/ then switch org to 'redwood-dev'.

Maya: I got Grafana access and the panels render now :tada: Accepted the Sentry invite too, I can see the 'api' project. One more question — is there a starter dashboard that combines traces + error rates? I'd like a template to base a first-pass dashboard on (traces, flamegraph, error rate, 5xx spikes).

Devon: yes, ping the observability team (observability@redwood.com) or open the internal dashboard request form: https://go.redwood/dashboard-request. We have a 'trace-starter-2024' template I can clone into your org. If you'd like I can clone it now and share link.

Priyanka: small tips — set dashboard var `environment` to `dev` and timeframe to 1h while you're exploring traces. Also check the panel variable `service` set to `api` to filter traces. Happy to pair for 15 minutes to walk through the template and connect Sentry error panels.

Maya: would love to pair — I'm free 3:00–4:00pm PST today.

Devon: 3:15pm PST works for me, I'll DM a calendar invite.

Maya: perfect, thanks everyone! Appreciate the fast help :raised_hands:
